ADD_LIBRARY (jolt INTERFACE)

TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES (jolt INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

IF (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
	TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES (jolt INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/debug/joltc.lib")
ELSEIF (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
	TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES (jolt INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/release/joltc.lib")
ELSE ()
	MESSAGE (FATAL_ERROR "Unknown build type: ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
ENDIF ()
